film_facts.title: Primetime
film_facts.critics_consensus: Turning the camera's scrutinizing eye back onto To Catch a Predator's journalistic legacy, Primetime interrogates the slippery boundary between justice and lurid spectacle with crackling style and an outstanding Robert Pattinson.
film_facts.critics_overview: Robert Pattinson received widespread acclaim from critics for his performance. Yet it’s hard to know to what end, or to care." Nicholas Barber of the BBC gave the film 5 out of 5 stars, calling Pattinson's performance "extraordinary" and "the best performance yet from the most intriguing actor of his generation".
